sourceClaimMap.claim: You can search the professional registers to find out about a person or an organisation registered or licensed with ASIC to provide a service
allows you to search several registers at once
ASIC’s professional registers include information on Australian financial services (AFS) licensees, AFS authorised representatives, credit licensees and credit representatives
You can search the professional registers by individual or company name, registration or licence number, ACN or ABN
ASIC is the national regulator for consumer credit and consumer leases under the national credit legislation
People that engage in credit activities generally need a credit licence or an authorisation from a licensee
the laws, and the protections they provide to borrowers, differ depending on the purpose of the loan
The law provides the lowest level of protection to commercial loans, including loans to small businesses
Lenders that only provide commercial loans are not required to have a credit licence and are not legally required to be a member of AFCA
AFCA can resolve complaints from small businesses about commercial lending, including loans to primary producers
AFCA can only resolve complaints about financial firms that are members of AFCA
ASIC encourages anyone who has concerns about commercial lending to seek independent legal advice as soon as possible
loans vary a lot in their costs and conditions, including the amount you can borrow, loan term, interest rate, set-up costs and ongoing fees
It's a good idea to compare loan products from multiple lenders before applying
Check for loans from non-bank lenders as well as traditional banks
A secured loan is backed up by collateral or security – something of value you have, such as property or your business inventory
If you don’t repay the loan, the lender can take the security to cover their losses

documentation requirements vary between loans, but you may need to provide proof of identification, a business plan, financial reports, including cash flow statements, financial forecasts, lease agreements and your personal financial information
to make sure it’s a real company, search for the name or ABN on the Australian Securities and Investments Commission (ASIC) register
